verdict.the_actual_rule: No '_' (underscore) may appear anywhere in a GBNF rule name on this llama.cpp build. Names are otherwise free - digits, letters, and '-' (dash) are all safe (Q3). The rule name has no relationship to its own JSON key; Q1b's 'must match the key' conclusion is refuted by this session's own Q1/Q2 results, not just by the brief's a-priori argument.
verdict.mechanism: Per the brief: llama.cpp's GBNF parser lexes rule names with an is_word_char predicate that accepts letters, digits, and '-', not '_'. An underscore terminates the identifier early and the parser chokes on the stray '_'. Not independently verified against llama.cpp source in this session - taken on the brief's own citation - but it is consistent with every data point across both Q1b and Q1c, with no exceptions found.
